claims: The federal tax filing deadline for individuals to submit 2025 tax returns is April 15, 2026.
Taxpayers can request an automatic 6-month extension by April 15, 2026.
An automatic 6-month extension moves the filing deadline to October 15, 2026.
An extension only grants more time to file, not more time to pay taxes owed.
Tax Day is April 15, 2026, for filing returns and paying any owed taxes.
First Quarter 2026 Estimated Tax Payment is due April 15, 2026.
Taxpayers stationed outside the U.S. and Puerto Rico on April 15 receive an automatic extension to June 16, 2026.
Failing to file on time can lead to a penalty of 5% of the tax due per month.
Electronic returns with refunds are typically processed within 21 days.
